articles.translatedExcerpt: Reira Shio released her new song ``Moshi,'' today. This song was written for Hulu x Nippon Television's new romance program ``In the Starry City'' with the themes of ``love'' and ``migration.'' ``In a Starry Town'' is about people who find it difficult to live in the city and want to stop and think about their own lives. This song, which was released on October 21st, was written as the theme song for the TV Asahi drama ``Animouto'' starring Nana Eikura and Eiji Akaso.Uru himself wrote and composed the song, and Yoshiaki Dewa was in charge of the arrangement. articles.title: Chuwi、全13曲を収録した新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Chuwiが2026年10月14日(水)にニューアルバム『Libertad』をリリースした。 全13曲、約45分にわたる本作。プエルトリコの歴史と文化、植民地主義の影響、社会的不平等、そして自らの未来を選び取る自由をテーマに据えた意欲作となっている。 『Libertad』とは、スペイン語で「自由」を意味する言葉。Chuwiはこの普遍的なテーマを、単なる政治的なスローガンとしてではなく、自分たちが生まれ育った土地で生きること、文化を守ること、そして次の世代に希望を繋ぐこととして描き出している。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4340975 アーティスト情報 https://www.instagram.com/chuwibeats/
articles.translatedTitle: Chuwi releases new AL containing 13 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Chuwi released his new album "Libertad" on Wednesday, October 14, 2026. This work has 13 songs and is approximately 45 minutes long. This is an ambitious work that explores the themes of Puerto Rico's history and culture, the effects of colonialism, social inequality, and the freedom to choose one's future. "Libertad" is a Spanish word that means "freedom". Chuwi depicts this universal theme not just as a political slogan, but as living in the land of one's birth, preserving one's culture, and passing on hope to the next generation. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4340975 Artist information https://www.instagram.com/chuwibeats/

articles.translatedTitle: TRIX member Noriaki Kumagai's solo project "NORIX" has started. The album will be released in January 2027.
articles.translatedExcerpt: Noriaki Kumagai, the drummer and main composer of the fusion band TRIX, has announced the start of a new solo project, ``NORIX.'' It has also been decided that the album "WHITE NOTES" will be released on January 13, 2027. Noriaki Kumagai joined the fusion band CASIOPEA in 1992. After participating in six albums, he formed TRIX in 2004. TRIX has released 22 original albums so far, and is currently actively conducting live tours. The solo project name ``NORIX'' started by Noriaki Kumagai, who is also the ``face'' of TRIX, is a play on his own name ``Noriaki.'' The title of the album, ``WHITE NOTES,'' says, ``From a fresh place, music that has never existed in this world...''

articles.excerpt: Shimon Hoshinoが2026年10月21日(水)にニューシングル「riding the light」をリリースした。 本作は、オーストラリア・タスマニアのFrying Pan Studiosで偶然出会った一台のWurlitzer（ウーリッツァー）を起点に制作された。初めて訪れた土地でありながら感じた不思議な懐かしさや、波のように揺らぐ時間の感覚を音へと昇華した。 土地に残る記憶や曖昧な体験が交差する瞬間を表現している。音・環境・身体の境界を横断しながら「人と環境の関係性」を探求し続けるShimon Hoshinoが贈る、聴き手自身の記憶や風景とも共鳴する1曲。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4336614 アーティスト情報 https://www.yo…
articles.translatedTitle: Shimon Hoshino releases new song that resonates with memories and scenery
articles.translatedExcerpt: Shimon Hoshino released his new single "riding the light" on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. This work was created based on a Wurlitzer that he happened to come across at Frying Pan Studios in Tasmania, Australia. He sublimated into sound the strange nostalgia he felt while visiting a place for the first time, and the sense of time swaying like waves. It expresses the moment when memories left in the land and ambiguous experiences intersect. A song that resonates with the listener's own memories and landscapes, presented by Shimon Hoshino, who continues to explore the "relationship between people and the environment" while crossing the boundaries of sound, environment, and body. articles.translatedTitle: Umiarashi releases first EP “HMU,AS I AIR”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Umiarashi released his first EP “HMU,AS I AIR” on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. This work includes a total of 7 songs with a rich variety, including ``Otona na ni Yuku'', which is a bold band arrangement of songs performed by Vo./Gt. Go Tanaka using a looper, ``Exploration Party's Night Song'', ``Kudaranae'', which he created with his former support members, and ``Daibakasha'', which was his first composition as Umiarashi. Starting with the lead single ``Aoi no Ao'', this album features technical and passionate performances that give a sense of each member's career path, as well as experimental arrangements. With a self-production system in which they handle everything from recording to mastering themselves, they embody the spirit of DIY and indie while simultaneously mixing and composing, pushing themselves outside the boundaries of the existing band sound.

articles.translatedTitle: GLAY's latest album "Waiting for the reason to travel" has been released. Official interview with leader TAKURO also released
articles.translatedExcerpt: GLAY released their first new album in two years, ``Waiting for the reason to travel,'' on October 21st. This work, which is the 18th album in total, is a work that condenses the thoughts of GLAY as the "next move" presented after running through the 30th anniversary year. Up until now, the traditional style was to produce new songs, release the sound source, and perform the completed songs on tour. However, leader TAKURO, who completed the 30th anniversary, had a strong desire to "value GLAY and myself more in the rapidly changing times. Let's once question what we took for granted." So for this album, just like in the early days of the band's formation, they write songs, work them out in the studio, and then deliver them live to their fans. The album was completed with a return to basics approach of turning the polished songs into sound sources and releasing them into the world.

articles.translatedTitle: N Feni releases new song “Vintage Mansion”
articles.translatedExcerpt: N Feni released a new song “Vintage Mansion” on October 21, 2026. "Vintage Mansion" is a song written, composed, arranged, and produced by Feni himself. Looking at the city in the night breeze, feeling the sadness of seeing the lights of other people's lives, the story depicts a man's feelings wavering between his yearning to live there someday and his desire to run out the moment it comes true. Humor and irony are imbued with life-like words such as ``somen noodles in the summer and hot pot in the winter,'' while the ending is full of life-sized reality as he envisions a future where he can spend time with his loved ones. The music video for "Vintage Mansion" directed by Hiraki has also been released. Set in the streets of Tainan, Taiwan, the film depicts daily life in a nostalgic way while touring pastel-colored walls and buildings lined with cutely decorated fences called "iron window flowers."

articles.translatedExcerpt: 3-piece rock band urei, based in Iwaki City, Fukushima Prefecture, will release their 1st mini album ``HOME'' on October 21st. This work is the first nationally distributed work by the group, who announced their affiliation with IKKI NOT DEAD with the single "BLOOM" dropped in March 2026. With the closing of club SONIC iwaki in Fukushima, where the band had been based since their formation in 2018, the six songs were created as a result of looking back on the eight years they spent at live houses, and are filled with love for their hometown and the fresh intention of ``starting a new story from here.'' Why does urei, whose work focuses on singalongs, sing fight songs? Behind the words "I'm not writing a fight song for anyone around me" is a worried and pathetic person...

This work is said to be a song that depicts the feeling that even if you keep searching for it, you can't grasp it in the midst of the amount of information and the noise of emotions in modern times. It is a middle tune that reflects the atmosphere of the times and the fluctuations of the heart in a chaotic whirlpool of emotions, and Mao Sasakawa handled the lyrics, composition, and arrangement. The music video was directed by Sota Fukushima, with Ryōshi Yamada, who worked on Rime's ``Jukugatsu'' and ``Nomane,'' serving as creative director. The new song ``Muku'' depicts the earnest desire to ``regain the feeling of pure innocence'' beyond the feeling of helplessness, self-loathing, and the urge to destroy everything. Fresh words such as ``Destroy this worthless me'' and ``I want to reduce my uncontrollable mind to zero'' collide with the fast-paced band sound, highlighting the momentum and conflict of the work. articles.translatedExcerpt: Ann and I have announced that ``Knife'' from our 1st major album ``ANN'', which will be released on November 4, 2026, will be pre-distributed tonight at 24:00. This song is said to be a rock number that depicts a love that has a sense of danger and fragility, where one even seeks to be hurt by the other person as a proof of love. articles.translatedExcerpt: Hitsuji Literature has announced that ``Saturday Night Theater'', a story born from ``Beyond the Night'' released in 2021, will be made into a movie. The Hitsuji Literature Award is a collaboration between Hitsuji Literature and monogatary.com, the novel posting site that produced YOASOBI. This work, ``Saturday Night Theater,'' is a film adaptation of the short story ``Saturday Night Theater'' (written by Yukiharu), which won the grand prize out of over 1,000 works at the second edition of the same award. The movie to be released this time is based on the same work, which was inspired by the song ``Beyond the Night'' by Hitsuji Bungaku, and adds original elements and new interpretations unique to the movie. A young movie geek with little experience in romance sets up a ``planned plan'' to write a script for a romantic movie...

articles.translatedTitle: [Interview] Dance Hall Crashers talk about their reunion and "Purr Deluxe" just before <AIR JAM 2026> "I feel really lucky to have had the opportunity again."
articles.translatedExcerpt: In January 2025, when it was announced that Dance Hall Crashers would reunite for the first time in 21 years, there were quite a few fans here in Japan who erupted with joy, proving once again the deep-rooted popularity of Dance Hall Crashers in Japan. Dance Hall Crashers is a ska-punk band formed in Berkeley, California in 1989. The band was originally started as a side project by Tim Armstrong and Matt Freeman, who were members of Operation Ivy, a band that pioneered ska-punk/ska-core, but when they decided to concentrate on their newly started Rancid, they re-emerged as a five-piece group fronted by two singers, Elyse Rogers and Karina Deniké.

articles.translatedExcerpt: Momoiro Clover Z held a live event ``Momoiro Autumn Peach God Festival 2026'' for two days on October 17th (Saturday) and 18th (Sunday) at Amagadai General Park in Chosei Village, Chosei District, Chiba Prefecture. We will deliver a report from the official. ◆Live photo The Momojin Festival is the first in 10 years. This time, we are collaborating with Chosei Village, Chiba Prefecture, to revive the event as the Autumn Peach God Festival, following in the footsteps of the large regional live event ``Momoclo Spring Ichidai'' (hereinafter referred to as ``Haruichi''), which has been held every spring. The opening ceremony for DAY 1 began with Takeshi Watanabe, vice mayor of Shibata City, Niigata Prefecture, where the Spring Festival was held last April, passing the ``Baton of Smiles'' to Takanao Okamoto, Mayor of Chosei Village, Chiba Prefecture. From 2014 to 2016, the Momoclo Festival was held as Momoclo's large-scale summer live event, where 8 million gods from all over Japan gathered together to celebrate Mononofu and Japan.

articles.title: Rachel Chinouriri、新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Rachel Chinouririが2026年10月16日(金)にニューアルバム『I think I spoke too soon』をリリースした。 全12曲、約40分にわたる本作は、ダンスフロアを彩るシンセポップの華やかさと、彼女ならではの繊細で率直なインディーポップを融合させた意欲作。20代前半から半ばにかけて経験する自己認識の変化、恋愛の混乱、そして大人になることの難しさを描いたアルバムとなっている。 サウンド面では、躍動感のあるシンセサイザー、ダンサブルなビート、オルタナティブロックの質感を融合。デビュー作で確立した親密なインディーポップの魅力を保ちながら、より洗練されたポップサウンドへと表現の幅を広げている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/432879…
articles.translatedTitle: Rachel Chinouriri, new AL release
articles.translatedExcerpt: Rachel Chinouriri released her new album ``I think I spoke too soon'' on Friday, October 16, 2026. This 12-song, approximately 40-minute album is an ambitious work that combines the glamor of dance floor synth pop with her signature delicate and frank indie pop. The album depicts the changes in self-perception, the confusion in love, and the difficulty of becoming an adult that people experience in their early to mid-20s. In terms of sound, it combines dynamic synthesizers, danceable beats, and alternative rock textures. While maintaining the intimate indie pop charm established in their debut album, they have expanded their range of expression to a more sophisticated pop sound. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/432879…

articles.excerpt: Sydney Roseが2026年10月16日(金)にニューEP『It Was My First Time』をリリースした。 全5曲で構成される本作は、親しい友人への初めての恋と、その関係がもたらした失望や心の痛みを中心に据えたパーソナルな作品。繊細な歌声と飾らない言葉で、相手の気持ちが分からない不安、自分自身への疑念、そして初めて経験する強烈な感情を描き出している。 恋愛の美しい側面だけでなく、その裏側にある混乱や傷つきやすさまで真正面から向き合った本作。聴く人自身の記憶や感情に静かに寄り添う一作となっている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4317581 アーティスト情報 https://www.instagram.com/sydneyrosemusic_/
articles.translatedTitle: Sydney Rose releases new personal EP
articles.translatedExcerpt: Sydney Rose released her new EP “It Was My First Time” on Friday, October 16, 2026. Consisting of five songs, this is a personal piece that centers on his first love for a close friend, and the disappointment and heartache that this relationship brings. With her delicate singing voice and simple words, she portrays the anxiety of not knowing what the other person is feeling, doubts about oneself, and the intense emotions experienced for the first time. This work squarely confronts not only the beautiful side of love, but also the confusion and vulnerability that lies behind it. It is a work that quietly touches the listener's own memories and emotions. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4317581 Artist information https://www.instagram.com/sydneyrosemusic_/

articles.translatedExcerpt: Reira Shio has announced that she will digitally release her new song "Moshi," on October 23, 2026. This song was written for Hulu x Nippon Television's new romance program ``In the Starry City'' with the themes of ``love'' and ``migration.'' ``In a Starry Town'' is about people who find it difficult to live in the city and want to stop and think about their own lives. If these troubled urban women meet rural men who have strong roots in their hometowns, will love ensue? And will they be able to find their true selves? This is a new romance program where adult women rediscover the charm of Japanese towns and discover who they truly wanted to be in life. ``Moshi,'' was created based on the concept of the program and the actual footage. I can't help but imagine what the world would be like...

articles.translatedExcerpt: Ashe released her new album ``The Girl Of Your Dreams'' on Friday, October 16, 2026. This work is a work of 11 songs that vividly depicts the emotions that can only be expressed by the person who is now, reconsidering the love, disappointment, conflict, and rebirth that he has experienced in his life. Combining the charms of pop, indie folk, and classic pop music, he transforms life's complexities into vibrant music. articles.translatedTitle: Joyce Wrice releases new AL with 14 songs

This work is the first full-length album in about 5 years since the debut album "Overgrown" in 2021. It pays homage to classic R&B from the 90s and 2000s, while blending it with modern beats and sophisticated production. This work depicts desire, confidence, intimacy, and self-understanding in love from multiple perspectives. A total of 14 songs, each lasting approximately 40 minutes, is an ambitious work that shows her expressive power as a singer and her maturity as a songwriter. articles.translatedTitle: Misaki Umei releases “doodle spring,” which takes her into a new realm with live drums as her starting point.
articles.translatedExcerpt: On Wednesday, October 14, 2026, Misaki Umei released her new single “doodle spring”. This work is a completely new song that has never been performed live. Hayao Ebihara, a drummer who is active in various venues including Haruomi Hosono's band, participated in the production. The drums were recorded for sampling in the studio, and a large number of rhythm patterns and tones were recorded. Umei himself reconstructed the material, making use of the texture of the live drums and creating an organic rhythm and ensemble that was different from his previous work, "L a d y." This is then layered with synth bass and vocals that rise from the ultra-low range, creating a track with a unique groove in which numerous rhythms develop fluidly. In the lyrics, scenes such as ``bright blue'' and ``beautiful night'' are described, along with descriptions of physical pain such as ``glass still stuck in my foot.''

Building on the genre-crossing musicality presented in their debut album "SUPERNOVA," this album features a more intimate and melodious sound centered around acoustic guitar, piano, and soft falsetto. This work shows a new creative direction, focusing not only on bold acoustic experiments but also on the beauty and emotional expression of the song itself. The title ``Amarillo'' is a Spanish word that means ``yellow.'' This song is a song that evokes images of the coast and the sun, as well as emotions related to love.
